vector<long long> clean(const vector<long long>& a) {
    for (int i = a.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        if (a[i] != 0) {
            if (i == (int)a.size() - 1) return a;
            return vector<long long>(a.begin(), a.begin() + i + 1);
        }
    }
    return vector<long long>();
}

vector<long long> mulnaive(const vector<long long>& a, const vector<long long>& b) {
    vector<long long> c(a.size() + b.size() - 1, 0);
    long long big = 8LL * MOD * MOD;
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)a.size(); i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < (int)b.size(); j++) {
            c[i + j] += a[i] * b[j];
            if (c[i + j] >= big) c[i + j] -= big;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)c.size(); i++) c[i] %= MOD;
    return c;
}

const int NTTPrimes[10] = {1053818881, 1051721729, 1045430273, 1012924417, 1007681537, 1004535809, 998244353, 985661441, 976224257, 975175681};

vector<long long> convoluteSimply(const vector<long long>& a, const vector<long long>& b, int P, int g) {

    vector<long long> fb = (a == b) ? fa : nttmb(b, m, false, P, g);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
        fa[i] = fa[i] * fb[i] % P;
    }
    return nttmb(fa, m, true, P, g);
}

vector<long long> convolute(const vector<long long>& a, const vector<long long>& b) {
    int USE = 2;
    int m = max(2, 1 << (32 - __builtin_clz(max((int)a.size(), (int)b.size()) - 1) + 2));
    vector<vector<long long>> fs(USE);

        vector<long long> fb = (a == b) ? fa : nttmb(b, m, false, P, g);
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            fa[i] = fa[i] * fb[i] % P;
        }
        fs[k] = nttmb(fa, m, true, P, g);
    }

    vector<int> mods(NTTPrimes, NTTPrimes + USE);
    vector<long long> gammas(USE);
    for (int k = 1; k < USE; k++) {
        long long prod = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            prod = prod * mods[i] % mods[k];

        gammas[k] = 1;

            long long d;
            d = a_val; a_val = b_val; b_val = d % b_val;
            d = p; p = q; q = d - c * q;

        if (p < 0) p += mods[k];
        gammas[k] = p;

    vector<int> buf(USE);

            res[k] = (buf[k] - temp) * gammas[k] % mods[k];
            if (res[k] < 0) res[k] += mods[k];
        }
        long long ret = 0;
        for (int j = USE - 1; j >= 0; j--) ret = ret * mods[j] + res[j];
        fs[0][i] = ret;
    }
    return fs[0];
}

vector<long long> nttmb(const vector<long long>& src, int n, bool inverse, int P, int g) {
    vector<long long> dst = src;
    dst.resize(n, 0);

    int h = 0;
    for (int temp = n; temp > 1; temp >>= 1) h++;

    long long K = 1LL << (32 - __builtin_clz(P));
    int H = (32 - __builtin_clz(K)) * 2;
    long long M = (K * K) / P;

    vector<int> wws(1 << max(0, h - 1));
    long long dw = inverse ? 1 : 0;
    {
        long long exp = (P - 1) / n;
        if (inverse) exp = P - 1 - exp;
        dw = 1;
        long long base = g;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if (exp & 1) dw = (dw * base) % P;
            base = (base * base) % P;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
    }

    long long w = (1LL << 32) % P;
    for (int k = 0; k < (int)wws.size(); k++) {
        wws[k] = (int)w;
        w = (w * dw) % P;
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < h; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < (1 << i); j++) {
            for (int k = 0, s = j << (h - i), t = s | (1 << (h - i - 1)); k < (1 << (h - i - 1)); k++, s++, t++) {
                long long u = (dst[s] - dst[t] + 2 * P) * wws[k];
                dst[s] += dst[t];
                if (dst[s] >= 2 * P) dst[s] -= 2 * P;
                long long Q = ((u << 32) * ((1LL << 64) - (P * ((1LL << 32) / P + 1)) / P) >> 32);
                dst[t] = (u >> 32) - (Q * P >> 32) + P;
            }
        }
        if (i < h - 1) {
            for (int k = 0; k < (1 << (h - i - 2)); k++) wws[k] = wws[k * 2];
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (dst[i] >= P) dst[i] -= P;
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int rev = 0;
        for (int j = 0; j < h; j++) {
            if (i & (1 << j)) rev |= (1 << (h - 1 - j));
        }
        if (i < rev) {
            long long d = dst[i];
            dst[i] = dst[rev];
            dst[rev] = d;
        }
    }

    if (inverse) {
        long long in = 1;
        long long base = n, exp = P - 2;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if (exp & 1) in = (in * base) % P;
            base = (base * base) % P;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) dst[i] = (dst[i] * in) % P;
    }

    return dst;
}
